description: A modern bathroom vanity set featuring a rectangular white sink integrated into a grey cabinet with two doors and silver knobs. Above the sink, a tall, rectangular mirror is mounted, reflecting the clean lines of the sink and faucet. The faucet itself is a sleek, minimalist design in a metallic finish. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and functional, designed for a contemporary bathroom space. The cabinet provides storage beneath the sink, and the mirror offers essential functionality for grooming and preparation.
